results.summary: This chip implements a single XOR gate and an inverter on a Tiny Tapeout tile. Inputs ui[0] and ui[1] feed the XOR, whose output appears on uo[0], while uo[2] and uo[3] provide inverted outputs. The project is intended as a basic logic gate test and includes a truth table for verification. It was created using the Wokwi editor and has no external hardware requirements.

The project is intended as a basic logic gate test and requires no external hardware. The documentation is minimal and does not clearly explain the intended function beyond the gate chain.
